name: decko-ts-composed
description: The TypeScript port with the composed default mod deck loaded (every ported card-mod manifest in the oracle bundle order), matching what stock Ruby Decko serves by virtue of bundling the card-mod gems. The corpus instrument (reference-harness/SPEC.md, section 4.2) renders through this adapter; the plain decko-ts adapter (no mods) stays the edge-parity reference.
